info.name: Marzi Senior Community — Unified API
info.description:
Single-collection API reference for the Marzi Senior Community backend.

All requests target ONE base URL via the unified API Gateway.

**Environment variables required:**
  `base_url`             - e.g. https://07fq4xqoi1.execute-api.ap-south-1.amazonaws.com (dev)
  `tenant_id`            - UUID of the target tenant (for Tenant Management PATCH calls)
  `access_token`         - JWT bearer token (obtain via Auth > Verify OTP)
  `event_id`             - sample event UUID (for Bookings / Campaigns flows)
  `booking_intent_token` - auto-populated by `[Campaign Tata 1mg] 1 · Initiate Booking`
  `razorpay_order_id`    - auto-populated by `[Campaign Tata 1mg] 1 · Initiate Booking`
  `campaign_name`        - defaults to `TATA_1MG`

**Folders:**
  1. Auth                  - OTP login, JWT refresh, profile & membership
  2. Users                 - profile, search, list, home stories & testimonials
  3. Events                - CRUD, publish, cancel, export registrations, admin list
  4. Bookings              - create, cancel, check-in, checkout flow, admin reports
                             + Campaign Tata 1mg public booking flow (no JWT)
  5. Campaign Config       - Admin CRUD for campaign_configs (max_discount, validity window, kill switch)
  6. Media                 - Image / document upload (S3 presigned POST) + DynamoDB metadata CRUD
  7. Groups                - CRUD, members, posts, comments, likes, timeline
  8. Speakers              - create, list, get, update, delete
  9. Moderation            - content moderation, blocked messages, rules
 10. Escalation            - dashboard queries, status updates
 11. Admin                 - status cards & testimonial management
 12. Tenant Management      - create tenants, toggle ACTIVE/INACTIVE (SUPER_ADMIN only)
 13. Tiered Ticketing v2   - multi-tier event ticketing (PRETIX_TIERED flow)

**Campaign Tata 1mg flow** — recommended request order:
  a. Admin: `Campaign Config > Create / Replace Campaign` once per environment (seed `TATA_1MG` row).
  b. Public: `Bookings > [Campaign Tata 1mg] 1 · Initiate Booking` — auto-saves `booking_intent_token` and `razorpay_order_id`.
  c. Public: `Bookings > [Campaign Tata 1mg] 2a · Free Register`  (when `payableAmount === 0`)
     OR `Bookings > [Campaign Tata 1mg] 2b · Confirm Paid Booking` (after Razorpay payment).

item.name: Auth

request.description:
Send a 4-digit OTP to a mobile number.

**phone** — required, E.164 format (e.g. `+919876543210`).

**tenant_name** — optional. The white-label tenant community name (e.g. `"Marzi"`). Case-insensitive. Defaults to `"Marzi"` when omitted — all legacy clients work unchanged.

Any existing live OTP for the same (tenant, phone) pair is invalidated. New OTP is valid for 10 minutes.

Errors:
- `400 TENANT_NOT_FOUND` — tenant_name provided but unknown
- `403 TENANT_INACTIVE` — tenant is deactivated

exec: pm.test('flat access alias is JWT',       () => pm.expect(res.access).to.match(/^ey/));
pm.test('flat refresh alias is JWT',      () => pm.expect(res.refresh).to.match(/^ey/));

request.description:
Verify OTP and receive JWT tokens.

**tenant_name** — optional. Must match the value sent in `send-otp`. Defaults to `"Marzi"`.

**Success response** (dual-envelope — legacy mobile client reads `response.data.data.access`, new clients use `accessToken`):  
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": { "access": "JWT", "refresh": "JWT", "is_onboard_completed": true },
  "accessToken": "JWT",
  "refreshToken": "JWT",
  "userId": "UUID",
  "isPioneer": true,
  "access": "JWT",
  "refresh": "JWT",
  "is_onboard_completed": true
}
```
- `accessToken` / `data.access` / `access` — identical JWT value (saved automatically)
- `refreshToken` / `data.refresh` / `refresh` — identical JWT refresh token. Valid for **30 days**.
- JWT claims now include `tid` (tenant UUID) and `tenant_name` for multi-tenant routing.
- `is_onboard_completed` — `false` routes to onboarding screen; `true` routes to home
- `isPioneer` — `true` for first 500 users **within the tenant**
- Access token TTL: **24 hours** | Refresh token TTL: **30 days**

Errors:
- `400 TENANT_NOT_FOUND` — tenant_name unknown
- `403 TENANT_INACTIVE` — tenant is deactivated

Exchange a valid refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair. Both tokens are rotated — the old refresh token should be discarded.

Send the refresh token (obtained from Verify OTP or a previous Refresh call) as `Authorization: Bearer <refreshToken>`.

**Response:**
```json
{
  "status": "success",
  "data": { "access": "JWT", "refresh": "JWT" },
  "accessToken": "JWT",
  "refreshToken": "JWT"
}
```
Access token TTL: **24 hours**. Refresh token TTL: **30 days**.

Returns 401 if refresh token is missing/invalid/expired. Returns 403 if account is SUSPENDED or DELETED.

Complete / update the Marzi onboarding profile. All fields are optional (at least one required). All body fields are **camelCase**.

**Field reference:**
| Field | Type | Allowed values |
|---|---|---|
| `fullName` | string | non-empty |
| `firstName` | string | optional alias; syncs with `fullName` |
| `lastName` | string | optional alias; syncs with `fullName` |
| `dateOfBirth` | string | YYYY-MM-DD, age ≥ 50 |
| `gender` | string | Male \| Female \| Other |
| `city` | string | optional alias of `location`; same allowed values |
| `location` | string | Bangalore \| Chennai \| Delhi \| Hyderabad \| Kolkata \| Mumbai (aliases normalized, e.g. Bengaluru/Bombay) |
| `educationLevel` | string | Undergraduate \| Postgraduate \| Life/Work \| Private |
| `educationInstitution` | string | free text |
| `travelFrequency` | string | 3+ times/year \| 1-2 times/year \| Rarely \| Never |
| `socialFrequency` | string | Daily \| 4-6 times/week \| 1-3 times/week \| 1-2 times/month \| Rarely |
| `preferredPayment` | string | Credit Card \| Debit Card \| UPI \| Net Banking |
| `interests` | string[] | array of non-empty strings |

Response includes `city`, `location`, and `totalScore` (0-100). `PATCH /v1/users/me` is a backward-compatible alias of this endpoint.

Returns the authenticated user's full onboarding profile plus:
- `memberId` — stable member ID in format `MARZI-NNNNNN` (rank among all historical registrations)
- `isPioneer` — `true` if rank ≤ 500
- `city` — city alias mirrored from profile location for backward compatibility
- `totalScore` — profile completion score (0-100)

Submit the onboarding screening answers.

Required fields:
- `educationLevel`: `postgraduate` | `undergraduate` | `life_work`
- `travelFrequency`: `frequently` | `yearly` | `occasionally` | `rarely`
- `socialFrequency`: `frequently` | `monthly` | `occasionally` | `rarely`
- `connectionIntent`: `interests` | `same_gender` | `similar_phase` | `other`
- `intentText` is required only when `connectionIntent` is `other`.

Response includes screening score, hard-gate status, and pass/fail outcome.

item.description:
Marzi multi-step onboarding flow.

Steps:
1. **Send OTP** — phone in E.164 format (`+91XXXXXXXXXX`)
2. **Verify OTP** — returns `accessToken` + `refreshToken`; test script saves both automatically
3. **Refresh Tokens** — exchange a refresh token for a new access + refresh token pair
4. **Update Profile** — all body fields are camelCase; use `fullName` (or `firstName`/`lastName` aliases)
5. **Get Membership** — returns profile + `memberId` (MARZI-NNNNNN format)
6. **Submit Screening** — evaluates onboarding eligibility and persists screening outcome

Endpoints 1–3 are public (no auth). Endpoints 4–6 require JWT.

`location` accepts canonical city names and common aliases (e.g. Bengaluru -> Bangalore, Bombay -> Mumbai). Responses include `totalScore` (0-100 profile completion score).

item.name: Users

request.description:
Returns the authenticated user's complete profile.

**Auth:** Bearer JWT (collection-level `{{access_token}}`).

**Response 200 — schema (camelCase canonical fields):**

| Field | Type | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| `userId` | string (UUID) | |
| `firstName` / `lastName` | string \| null | |
| `email` | string \| null | verified email |
| `pendingEmail` | string \| null | staged email awaiting verification |
| `phone` | string | E.164 format |
| `dateOfBirth` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) \| null | |
| `pendingDob` | string (YYYY-MM-DD) \| null | staged DOB awaiting verification |
| `type` | string \| null | onboarding member type |
| `profilePicUrl` | string \| null | |
| `bio` | string \| null | |
| `role` | string | `USER` \| `ADMIN` \| `SUPER_ADMIN` |
| `accountStatus` | string | `ACTIVE` \| `SUSPENDED` \| `DELETED` |
| `discountCredits` | number | rupees in user's credit balance |
| `totalBadges` | integer | count of badges awarded |
| `createdAt` | string (ISO-8601) | |
| `username` | string \| null | |
| `hasFirstPost` | boolean | |
| `locationVisibility` | boolean | |
| `firstEventCoupon` | object | see below |

**`firstEventCoupon` — first-event welcome discount block:**
```json
{
  "eligible": true,   // user has NOT yet redeemed any first-event discount
  "redeemed": false,  // inverse of eligible — true once consumed
  "amount":   500     // discount value in rupees (configurable via env)
}
```
Mirror of `users.first_event_coupon_redeemed`. Flipped to `redeemed=true` when **any** discount-bearing first booking is confirmed (regular checkout or any campaign flow such as `TATA_1MG`). Use it to gate "₹X off your first event" UI. **The actual discount is re-evaluated at checkout — treat this field as advisory, not authoritative.**

**Legacy snake_case aliases** (kept for Django-era clients — do NOT rely on these in new code):
`profile_picture`, `has_first_post`, `phone_number`.

**Errors:**
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED` — missing or invalid JWT
- `404 USER_NOT_FOUND` — token user no longer exists

request.description:
Returns home-screen status cards visible to end users — server-enforced filter `is_deleted = FALSE AND status = 'published' AND visible_to_users = TRUE AND image_key IS NOT NULL`. Ordered newest-first.

**Auth:** None — public endpoint, no Authorization header required.

**Query params:**
- `limit` (optional): integer 1–50, default 20. Out-of-range values clamped; non-numeric falls back to default.

**Response 200:**
```json
{
  "statuses": [
    {
      "status_id":   "e307cb94-f773-4b2e-8705-a85287f976d8",
      "description": "Welcome to the May community drive",
      "image_url":   "https://cdn.marzi.life/statuses/e307cb94.../image.webp",
      "created_at":  "2026-05-12T17:49:54.444Z",
      "updated_at":  "2026-05-12T17:49:54.444Z"
    }
  ]
}
```

Returns an empty list (`{"statuses": []}`) when no cards match — never 404. Admin-only fields (`created_by`, `image_key`, `status`, `visible_to_users`) are intentionally omitted from this projection.

**Image fetching:** `image_url` is anonymously readable — clients can `GET` it directly (no Authorization header). The S3 bucket has a scoped public-read policy on `statuses/*` and `home/*` prefixes; writes still require a presigned PUT URL signed by the Lambda.

Use `PATCH /v1/user/profile` for new clients. If you call this alias, send the same onboarding fields (`fullName`, `dateOfBirth`, `gender`, `location`, `educationLevel`, `travelFrequency`, etc.).

Returns the public profile subset for any non-deleted user: `userId`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `profilePicUrl`, `bio`, `totalBadges`.

**SUPER_ADMIN callers** additionally receive three aggregate counters in the same response:
- `totalEvents` — confirmed/used ticket count (tickets where status IN ('CONFIRMED','USED'))
- `totalTransactions` — successful payment count (payments where status='SUCCEEDED')
- `totalPosts` — active post count (posts where status='ACTIVE')

Non-admin callers see the existing public shape unchanged.

Each `items[*]` entry contains: `userId`, `firstName`, `lastName`, `phone`, `email`, `role`, `accountStatus`, `createdAt`, and the following onboarding/activity fields:
- `isOnboardingCompleted` (boolean) — true once the user has a name set
- `eventsBooked` (int) — confirmed/used ticket count
- `isFirstDiscountApplied` (boolean) — true if the first-event coupon has been redeemed

Full-text + filter search. Returns `{ items[], total, limit, offset }`. At least one of `q` or a `filter[*]` param is required. SUPER_ADMIN only.

Each `items[*]` entry includes the same base fields as List Users (`userId`, names, contact, role, status, `type`, `city`, `createdAt`) **plus**:

- `eventsBooked` (int) — confirmed/used ticket count
- `isFirstDiscountApplied` (boolean) — first-event coupon redemption flag

item.description:
User profile management and discovery.

All endpoints require JWT. `GET /users` and `GET /users/search` are **SUPER_ADMIN only**.

`PATCH /v1/users/me` is a deprecated alias of `PATCH /v1/user/profile` and follows the onboarding profile schema.

All request/response body fields use **camelCase**.

Create a new event (status starts as `DRAFT`). Returns presigned S3 PUT URLs for hero image and 5 gallery images (WebP, 1hr TTL).

**event_mode:** `ONLINE` | `OFFLINE`
- `ONLINE` → `online_event_url` required; `online_access_code` optional
- `OFFLINE` → `venue_name`, `address_line1`, `city_id` (UUID from `GET /v1/cities`), `state`, `postal_code`, `latitude`, `longitude` required

⚠️ `city_id` must be a valid UUID — call `GET /v1/cities` first and set the `{{city_id}}` collection variable.

**Timestamp rules:** booking_start < booking_end < event_start < event_end. `event_start_time` must be at least 24 hours in the future.

`slug` is auto-generated from `title` if omitted; must be unique per organizer.

**Images (URL-only):** `hero_image_url` (string) and `gallery_image_urls` (array, max 14) accept externally-hosted `http`/`https` image URLs and are stored as-is. Independent of the presigned-S3 flow above — use whichever fits the client.

request.description:
List all PUBLISHED events, ordered by `event_start_time` ascending. Returns pagination metadata, `venue_name`, and available_slots per event.

**Date filtering:** By default returns only live and future events (`event_end_time > NOW()`). Pass `filter_date_from` to override the cutoff. Pass a past date (e.g. `2020-01-01`) to include historical events. Invalid date values return `400 INVALID_REQUEST`.

Update an event you own. Platform `ADMIN` / `SUPER_ADMIN` can update any event.

**Optional `status` field — same call can also flip the lifecycle state:**

  - `"COMPLETED"` → 400; this status is server-managed only.

    `OFFLINE` clears online-only fields and requires `venue_name` + `city_id`.

    event_end_time`. Violations return 400.

**Response 200 (always — even when no discount applies):**
```json

  "originalAmount": 1000,
  "discountAmount": 500,
  "payableAmount": 500,
  "discountApplied": true,
  "campaignName": "TATA_1MG",
  "bookingIntentToken": "bit1.eyJ0eXAi...",
  "razorpay_order_id": "order_SkwOY0HzjaVxzJ",
  "requiresPayment": true,

```

**Branching after this call:**
- `requiresPayment === false` → call `Step 2a · Free Register`
- `requiresPayment === true`  → open Razorpay, then call `Step 2b · Confirm Paid Booking`

**Test script** auto-saves `booking_intent_token` and `razorpay_order_id` as collection variables.

- `400 INVALID_REQUEST` — bad name/phone/dob/event_id

- `404 EVENT_NOT_FOUND` — `event_id` does not exist
- `400 EVENT_NOT_PUBLISHED` — event is DRAFT/CANCELLED
- `409 ALREADY_BOOKED` — same user already has a CONFIRMED booking for this event
- `409 COUPON_CONFLICT` — in-flight reservation; wait for it to finalize or expire (15 min TTL)

request.description:
**Step 2a — Use only when `payableAmount === 0` from `/initiate`.**

Finalizes the booking without going through Razorpay. The booking-intent token is the only auth; do NOT include `Authorization`.

**Request:** No body. Header `X-Booking-Intent-Token` is auto-populated from the collection variable saved by Step 1.

**Response 201:**
```json
{
  "status": "CONFIRMED",
  "bookingId": "uuid",
  "confirmationNumber": "SCM-2026-0512-7421",
  "finalAmount": 0,
  "couponApplied": true,
  "campaignName": "TATA_1MG",
  "paymentId": "FREE_BOOKING"
}
```

**Idempotency:** Replaying the same token returns `200 ALREADY_CONFIRMED` with the same `bookingId` — safe to retry on network errors.

**Errors:**
- `400 PAYMENT_REQUIRED` — token's `payable_amount > 0`; use `Step 2b · Confirm Paid Booking` instead
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED` — missing/invalid/expired token (15 min TTL)
- `409 STALE_BOOKING_INTENT` — event price changed since `/initiate`; re-initiate
- `409 DISCOUNT_NOT_RESERVED` — DynamoDB record missing or JTI mismatch; re-initiate
- `409 ALREADY_BOOKED` — user already has CONFIRMED booking for this event

**Step 2b — Use only when `payableAmount > 0` from `/initiate` and Razorpay returned success in the client.**

**Canonical path** for confirming a paid Tata 1mg booking. The legacy alias `POST /v1/checkout/{orderId}/confirm` (see request `2c`) routes to the same Lambda handler and is kept for backwards compatibility — both produce identical responses.

The server picks the campaign branch when `X-Booking-Intent-Token` is present AND no `Authorization` Bearer JWT. The booking is identified by the JTI inside the token (not the URL), which is why the canonical path needs no path parameter.

**Request body:** Razorpay's `razorpay_order_id`, `razorpay_payment_id`, `razorpay_signature` from the client SDK response.

**Response 201:** Confirms the booking. `couponApplied` reflects whether a discount was actually applied (matches the `discountApplied` field from `/initiate`).

**Errors:**
- `400 INVALID_SIGNATURE` — Razorpay HMAC failed; the DDB reservation is auto-transitioned to FAILED so the user can retry `/initiate` immediately
- `400 PAYMENT_AMOUNT_MISMATCH` — captured amount ≠ token's `payable_amount`; do NOT retry without verifying Razorpay
- `400 INVALID_REQUEST` — missing razorpay_* fields, or `payable_amount === 0` (use `/free-register` instead)
- `401 UNAUTHORIZED` — missing/invalid/expired booking intent token
- `409 STALE_BOOKING_INTENT` — event price changed; re-initiate (and refund the existing payment)
- `409 DISCOUNT_NOT_RESERVED` — DDB record missing/wrong JTI; re-initiate (and refund the existing payment)

Admin CRUD for `campaign_configs` — the table that drives the campaign-discount eligibility evaluated at `/v1/campaigns/{name}/bookings/initiate`.

**Auth:** All endpoints require ADMIN or SUPER_ADMIN JWT (`Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`).

**Bootstrap order on a new environment:**
1. Create the campaign row (`POST /admin/campaigns`) BEFORE announcing the campaign to users — otherwise `/initiate` returns `404 CAMPAIGN_NOT_FOUND`.
2. To soft-disable a running campaign without affecting in-flight bookings, `PUT /admin/campaigns/{name}` with `{ "is_active": false }`.
3. To extend the validity window, `PUT` with a new `end_date`.

**Validity rules evaluated at `/initiate`:**
- Row must exist (Rule 1 → 404 if missing)
- `is_active = TRUE` (Rule 2)
- `now` ∈ `[start_date, end_date]` if either is set (Rule 3)
- No CONFIRMED DDB redemption for `(user_id, campaign_name)` (Rule 4)

Rules 2–4 do NOT block booking — they return 200 with `discountApplied: false` and full ticket price. Campaign eligibility is independent of the regular first-event coupon — a user who already received the normal first-event discount remains eligible for any campaign they have not previously redeemed.

item.description:
Generic image + document upload service.

Pattern: backend issues a short-lived presigned S3 POST URL with a server-side `content-length-range` policy. Client uploads the binary directly to S3 — Lambda never sees the bytes, so the API scales independently of file size.

**Size limits (enforced by S3, not honor system):**
  - Images: ≤ 1 MB (image/webp · image/png · image/jpeg · image/gif)
  - Documents: ≤ 5 MB (pdf · doc · docx · xls · xlsx · txt · csv)

**Visibility** is decided at upload time and is immutable. To switch, delete and re-upload.

**Auth model:** same endpoints for App and Admin Panel.
  - Customers see / manage only their own uploads.
  - Admins (`role=admin` in JWT) can list and delete anyone's.
  - Public assets are readable anonymously (no JWT needed for the
    direct `public_url`); the `GET /media/{id}` metadata endpoint still
    requires JWT for private assets.

**Recommended flow:**
  1. `Create Media` → save `asset_id`, `upload.url`, `upload.fields`.
  2. Multipart POST the binary to `upload.url` using `upload.fields` as
     form fields and the file as the LAST field named `file`.
  3. `Confirm Media Upload` to flip the row from PENDING → ACTIVE and
     capture `size_bytes`.

item.description:
Multi-tier event ticketing using the PRETIX_TIERED flow.

Prerequisites: Event must have ticketing_mode = 'PRETIX_TIERED' and be linked to Pretix via pretix_event_map.

3-step booking flow:
1. GET /v2/events/{eventId}/tiers  — browse tiers
2. POST /v2/events/{eventId}/cart  — reserve inventory in Pretix
3. POST /v2/cart/{cartId}/checkout — apply coupon + create Razorpay order
4. Open Razorpay SDK payment sheet
5. POST /v2/cart/{cartId}/confirm  — submit payment result

Kill switch: All routes return 503 FEATURE_DISABLED if PRETIX_TIERED_ENABLED != 'true'.

Collection variables: event_id, tier_id, cart_id, razorpay_order_id, confirmation_number
